item.text: {"search_note":"I searched Reuters, Freedom House, Council of Federation, and Kremlin material for 2024 evidence of real institutional strengthening. I did not find a credible 2024 case where Putin empowered courts, legislatures, audit bodies, or local governments in a way that clearly increased their ability to constrain him. The closest items were procedural activity or fiscal tinkering, not independence.","evidence":[{"title":"Russia: Nations in Transit 2024 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/nations-transit/2024","summary":"Freedom House notes that in June 2024 Putin directed the cabinet to improve municipal finances by changing tax-revenue allocation methods. This is a narrow fiscal adjustment for local government, but the same report says local autonomy had already been folded into the state hierarchy and municipalities lacked real financial independence.","question_ids":["4B.4"]},{"title":"Об отчете о работе Счетной палаты Российской Федерации в 2024 году","publisher":"Council of Federation of the Russian Federation","date":"2025-03-27","url":"https://council.gov.ru/activity/documents/165336/","summary":"The Federation Council reported that the Audit Chamber carried out 235 control measures, 60 expert-analytic measures, and 44 other measures in 2024. This shows the oversight body remained active, but it does not show Putin strengthened its independence or accepted constraint by it.","question_ids":["4B.4"]},{"title":"Russia: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Freedom House says the judiciary lacks independence, judges’ careers depend on Kremlin compliance, and the president can remove Constitutional Court and Supreme Court judges with Federation Council support. That is direct evidence against strengthening independent courts.","question_ids":["4B.4","4B.2"]},{"title":"Russia: Nations in Transit 2024 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/nations-transit/2024","summary":"The report says local government autonomy eroded after the 2020 constitutional changes, municipalities lacked financial independence, and regional and local bodies remained aligned with the Kremlin. That is evidence of continued centralization, not empowerment of local oversight.","question_ids":["4B.4","4B.2"]},{"title":"Putin lets 'economically significant' entities limit information disclosures","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-01-29","url":"https://uk.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/putin-lets-economically-significant-entities-limit-information-disclosures-3315001","summary":"Reuters reported that Putin widened secrecy privileges so entities deemed economically significant could stop disclosing information publicly. That reduces transparency and weakens external scrutiny rather than strengthening oversight.","question_ids":["4B.4","4B.2"]}]}
